turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! How is your Friday going so far? Winding down from a shift, or just getting your day started in Phoenix?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Just getting my day started. I decided to skip the coffee today and made myself a hot, spiced black tea latte with steamed milk. It's the perfect cozy start.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious! Did you use your roommate's new espresso machine to froth the milk, or did you do it the old-fashioned way?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually used her machine's steam wand! It worked perfectly. After that, I had to run some errands across town. The Phoenix sun is already intense today, so instead of driving myself, I ended up booking a ride on one of those transport apps to get around.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Smart move to avoid the heat and the traffic! Did you have a chance to listen to anything interesting during the ride?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I put my headphones in and queued up a hilarious show where a couple of stand-up comics dissect weird internet drama. I was laughing out loud the whole ride; the driver probably thought I was eccentric.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Haha, there's nothing better than a good laugh to start the day. Speaking of fun things, have you gotten a chance to do any salsa dancing lately, or has work been keeping you too busy?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Work has been pretty busy, but I did manage to squeeze in some sourdough baking earlier this week. The Phoenix warmth actually makes the dough rise incredibly fast.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's awesome. Did Tom get to try a slice of your latest loaf?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He did! He came over on Wednesday and we toasted some up. He said it was my best batch yet, which made me feel great.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's a huge compliment! Are you scheduled for a night shift at the ER tonight, or do you have the weekend off?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I do have a shift tonight. I'm just relaxing at home for a bit longer before I have to get ready to head in. Hopefully, it's a smooth night!
